name: @offgridsec/kira-lite-mcp

tools.name: scan_code
tools.description: Scan code for security vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, CWEs, hardcoded secrets, insecure crypto, injection flaws) AND automatically check any newly imported packages (not yet in the project manifest) against the OSV advisory database. Call BEFORE writing any code to disk.

code.description: The code to scan for vulnerabilities

language.description: Programming language (javascript, typescript, python, go, java, etc.)

filename.description: Intended filename — used for language detection

project_path.description: Project root directory — used to locate the manifest (package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml) when detecting newly imported packages. Defaults to the server's working directory.

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan an existing file on disk for security vulnerabilities.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to scan

tools.name: scan_diff
tools.description: Compare original vs modified code and report only NEW vulnerabilities introduced by your changes.

tools.name: fix_vulnerability
tools.description: Get detailed fix guidance for a specific vulnerability by its ID (e.g., KIRA-JS-SQLI-001) or CWE (e.g., CWE-89).

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Get the current Kira-Lite scan configuration.

tools.name: set_config
tools.description: Update Kira-Lite configuration. Use this to change scan frequency.

scanMode.description: Scan mode: "every-edit" (block on findings), "warn" (scan but never block, default), "on-save" (file scans only), or "manual" (all scans off)

tools.name: scan_dependencies
tools.description: Scan project dependencies for known vulnerabilities (CVEs) using the OSV.dev database. Parses lockfiles (package-lock.json, yarn.lock, requirements.txt, go.sum, Cargo.lock, etc.) and reports vulnerable packages with fix versions.

project_path.description: Directory to scan for lockfiles (auto-detects lockfile type)

lockfile_path.description: Path to a specific lockfile to scan
